fixes: Cloth width and proportion (seed 1): the generator makes cloth_w = w - 2*(0.06 + 0.08) = 0.92 m on the 1.2 m hero. The canonical cloth measures about 285 x 545 px (w:h about 0.52). In sheet-mod-lights #7 the 'W 1.20 m' arrow spans the cloth edges, not the rod. The cloth there measures 220 x 285 px (w:h about 0.77; the labels give 0.67). Target: 1.2 m wide cloth (w:h at least 0.67) with the rod overhanging 0.08 m plus 0.06 m caps each side (rod about 1.48 m), which keeps the r1 overhang target. This needs the proxy widened to about 1.5 m (lead).

Drape still reads as flat boards: r2 fix 1 has not visibly landed. The canonical and styles panels are planar, with only faint streaks near the hem. Shorten the ripple wavelength to about 0.07-0.09 m (5-6 ripples per 0.46 m panel) at about 3-4 cm peak-to-peak at the hem. Add the 2-3 cm forward belly over the lower third that r2 asked for. Give the canonical a raking key light 35-45 degrees off-axis so the folds read. Check that smooth_angle=70 isn't flattening the shading across the ripple columns.

Tab loops: the canonical shows 6 tabs and the cream seed shows 8. At about 50% duty they read as a black-and-white checker strip under the rod. Concept #7: 5 loops about 0.07 m wide on about 0.25 m centres (about 30% duty), with the wooden rod clearly visible between them. Cap at 5 tabs per 1.2 m (n_splits+2 minimum, as r2 asked), with spacing of at least 0.2 m.

LOD2/LOD3 rod on seed 2 (half noren): LOD0/1 show a bronze tube with finials, but LOD2 renders a flat black bar and LOD3 a dark speckled bar. Keep the bronze (or hinoki) slot on the reduced rod so the colour holds across the switch.

Cloth colour and weave (generator side, alongside the library fix): the indigo samples at about #2C2E3A (near-neutral slate) against the concept's #1E2A40. Black samples at about #302B27 (warm brown-grey), while the 09 black noren reads blue-charcoal. No slub weave shows at 2 m. Until the library lands, push the indigo tint toward blue saturation (more B, less R/G), set black to a cool charcoal, and raise the albedo streak/variation over normal_strength 1.8.

Crest lettering: 'KAZAN-YU' renders in a heavy grotesque. The concept uses thin, widely spaced serif capitals, about 0.4 em tracking, set narrower than the mountain. Swap the glyph set or widen the tracking. Low priority.

summary: This reads as the Kazan-yu noren. The full crest with KAZAN-YU / 火山湯 is there, the hero is a two-panel centre-slit door noren with tab loops on a turned wooden rod with bronze caps and brackets, and the colour set and full/half/wide/sleeve variants hold up. LOD2/LOD3 keep the split, the rod and the peak at 16 m and 44 m. It isn't there yet: the hero cloth is about 30% too narrow against the concept, the panels still hang like flat boards with no drape, the tabs read as a checker strip, and the indigo/black colours are off, which is mostly a library issue.
